title: Generate initial crystal structures
action: Create the I42d chalcopyrite structures for LiMS2 (M=Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni) and the delithiated compositions Li_xMS2 (x=0.75, 0.5, 0.25, 0) using lattice constants and atomic positions described in the paper. Also prepare the BCC Li metal unit cell.
description: Generates all necessary initial structures for subsequent DFT relaxations. Not scored.

title: HSE06 relaxation of compositions
action: Using CP2K with the HSE06 hybrid functional, relax the unit cells of all Li_xMS2 compositions (for each M and x) and BCC Li metal. Collect the final total energies and relaxed unit-cell volumes.
description: Required to obtain accurate total energies for voltage and volume calculations. Not scored directly, but downstream scored steps depend on its outputs.

title: Extract formation energies
action: From the HSE06-relaxed structures, compute the total energy per formula unit for each Li_xMS2 composition and write to /app/outputs/formation_energies.csv.
description: Contains the total energy (in eV) per formula unit for every M and x. The checker will use these values together with the Li metal energy to compute average intercalation voltages via the standard formation-energy-to-voltage formula.
output_schema: CSV with columns: material (e.g., LiCrS2), Li_content_x (float, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25, 0.0), formation_energy_eV_per_fu (float, total energy).

title: Extract relaxed volumes
action: From the same HSE06-relaxed unit cells, record the volume of LiMS2 and MS2 (fully delithiated) and write to /app/outputs/relaxed_volumes.csv.
description: Contains the unit-cell volumes for the end members. The checker will compute the volume change percentage as (V(MS2)-V(LiMS2))/V(LiMS2)*100.
output_schema: CSV with columns: material (e.g., LiCrS2), composition (LiMS2 or MS2), volume_ang3 (float).

title: Bulk NEB migration barriers
action: For each LiMS2 (M=Cr,Mn,Fe,Co,Ni), build a 2×2×1 supercell with one Li vacancy, relax the endpoints with PBE (CP2K), then perform CI-NEB with PBE to obtain the minimum energy path. Save the total energy of each NEB image to /app/outputs/neb_energy_profiles.json.
description: Raw energy profiles for Li vacancy migration. The checker computes the migration barrier as max(profile) - min(profile) (excluding endpoints) and compares to the paper's reported barriers.
output_schema: JSON object: keys are material names (LiCrS2, LiMnS2, LiFeS2, LiCoS2, LiNiS2); each value is an array of total energies (eV) for images 0 through N.

title: Build and relax LiCrS2/Li3PS4 interface
action: Construct the LiCrS2(112)/β-Li3PS4(010) interface supercell following the paper's procedure (Li- and Cr-terminated (112) surface matched with S-terminated LPS (010), lattice mismatch ≤ 6.45%). Relax the interface with PBE.
description: Prepares the interface model needed for the interface NEB. Not scored.

title: Interface NEB migration barrier
action: Using the relaxed interface, identify a Li diffusion path from LiCrS2 bulk to Li3PS4 bulk, and perform CI-NEB (PBE) to compute the energy profile. Write the image energies to /app/outputs/interface_neb_profile.json.
description: Energy profile for Li crossing the interface. The checker computes the barrier (max - min, excluding endpoints) and compares to the paper's value.
output_schema: JSON array of total energies (eV) for each NEB image.
